thread:
Sam Patel: FYI I'm getting a surge of pages for embeddings-serving in us-west. primary instances are hitting 5xx for some customers. I'm taking first pass — no full escalation yet, but will hand off if I leave.
incident-bot: INC31234 triggered - embeddings_us_west p99 latency > 2s AND 500-rate > 0.1% :rotating_light:
Sam Patel: Symptoms: sudden traffic spike from a few large customers + increased KV cache eviction. Errors are mainly 502 gateway on model-proxy, not model OOMs. See metrics: https://grafana.internal/d/embeddings/us-west
Jordan Li: I'm on standby. Are we seeing KV eviction rates? If so, prefetched KV might be thrashing.
Mei Chen: Confirmed. KV eviction rate up x6 last 10m, prim/sec memory pressure up. No OOMs in logs. Rolling back prefetch would be quick.
Sam Patel: Mitigations in-progress: 1) throttling top-5 noisy API keys (temp rate-limit) 2) disable prefetch worker group us-west 3) scale up secondary pool + warm replicas.
Priya Rao: I'll apply the rate-limit rule now for the top noisy keys, adding 20rps per key cap. Ping me if we need to rollback.
Priya Rao: done — rate-limits applied. Commands:
```
# temp rate limit
./opsctl ratelimit apply --region us-west --api-keys K1,K2,K3 --limit 20
```
Carlos Vega: Scaling plan: triggering +2 instances in dedicated pool (t2g), expected warm in ~3m. If prim/sec mismatch persists we can shift routing to secondary pool via traffic-weight 30%.
Jordan Li: I'll stand up the traffic-weight shift play if errors don't fall in 6m. Also watching model-proxy logs for 502 cause (upstream timeouts vs conn resets).
Mei Chen: Added a guard in the KV layer: lowering eviction aggressiveness and bumping cache TTLs from 60s to 120s for embeddings namespace.
Sam Patel: Customer impact: some customers see intermittent 502 on embeddings and increased latency (p95 ~1.6s -> 2.4s). Tiered SLA check: none in immediate breach, but could for bursty customers. Draft outbound in #support needed if persists.
Priya Rao: Noted. I'll prepare a short support blurb but waiting 10m to see mitigation effect.
incident-bot: Update: INC31234 -> severity: elevated, pages ongoing. Pager rota: @Jordan Li primary -> escalate to @Mei Chen if not acknowledged in 15m.
Jordan Li: Acknowledging. I'm primary for next hour unless I hand off. Briefing: primary=Jordan, secondary=Mei, backup=Carlos. Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-ratewave and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction
Sam Patel: Handoff notes: persisted high eviction + proxy 502s, rate-limits applied, prefetch disabled, cache TTL increased, scaling +2 in progress. If errors drop, begin gradual traffic weight rollback after 10m observation.
Mei Chen: Observability hooks I set: added a dashboard filter and an alert mute for noisy key once rate-limit rolled. Also exported a small trace for a failed request: https://jaeger.internal/traces/31234
Jordan Li: I'll stay on until 3176544988, then hand off to Mei. If things worsen, escalate to eng-sre and wake oncall lead.
Carlos Vega: If secondary pool warms successfully and 502s persist, we'll shift 20% traffic and monitor for 10m. Otherwise prepare fallback: readonly embeddings endpoint (degraded but stable) - runbook section 3.
Sam Patel: OK, thanks everyone. Leaving for a short break. Jordan primary, Mei secondary. @support please hold any customer messages for 20m while we observe.
Mei Chen: Copy. I'll take over if Jordan needs to step out. Current status: errors decreased by ~40% since rate-limit, eviction down ~30%. Continuing to monitor :thumbsup:
Jordan Li: Noted, will update bridge if anything changes. Last update timestamp: 3176544988
